Title: customerReviews — filter reviewStatus:New / reviewStatus:Rejected does not expose unmoderated reviews to an anonymous caller
Preconditions: Runner-native. Requires `npm run seed:reviews` (REVIEW_PRODUCT carries approved_count Approved reviews PLUS new_count New and rejected_count Rejected — all three counts are written to aliases.<env>.json by the seeder and read here through @td(), never typed) — same fixture as REV-GQL-013. Caller terms must not change which reviews a storefront caller sees: the status scope is forced after the filter is mapped. Anonymous: no [AUTH] on the storefront ops. VCST-6251 fix build: CustomerReviews >= 3.1008.0-pr-86 (pre-fix returned the New / Rejected review for these filters, to anonymous callers too).
Steps:
[GQL-OP unfiltered]
  query { customerReviews(storeId: "{{STORE_ID}}" entityId: "{{product}}" entityType: "Product" first: 50) { totalCount items { id reviewStatus } } }
[GQL-EXEC unfiltered]
[GQL-CAPTURE unfiltered.data.customerReviews.totalCount → VISIBLE_TOTAL]
[GQL-OP filter_new]
  query { customerReviews(storeId: "{{STORE_ID}}" entityId: "{{product}}" entityType: "Product" first: 50 filter: "reviewStatus:New") { totalCount items { id reviewStatus } } }
[GQL-EXEC filter_new]
[GQL-OP filter_rejected]
  query { customerReviews(storeId: "{{STORE_ID}}" entityId: "{{product}}" entityType: "Product" first: 50 filter: "reviewStatus:Rejected") { totalCount items { id reviewStatus } } }
[GQL-EXEC filter_rejected]
[AUTH role=ADMIN_DEFAULT]
[REST-OP admin_all]
  POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/customerReviews/search
  Content-Type: application/json
  Body: {"entityIds": ["{{product}}"], "entityType": "Product", "take": 100}
[REST-EXEC admin_all]
Cross_Layer_Checks: [ADMIN] the admin search (all statuses) holds exactly new_count New and rejected_count Rejected reviews on this product (and approved_count Approved), more than the storefront shows — so the hidden reviews exist and their absence under reviewStatus:New / reviewStatus:Rejected is the fix, not an empty fixture
Failure_Signals: totalCount differs from approved_count under a reviewStatus filter; items contain reviewStatus NEW or REJECTED; admin holds fewer New / Rejected reviews than new_count / rejected_count, or its total is not above the visible total (the fixture holds no hidden review — the case is vacuous, report BLOCKED, re-run seed:reviews); errors[] non-empty
References: VCST-6251; xAPI; graphql-schema.md — Query.customerReviews; KB-944D8F51; vc-module-customer-review#86; Archetype:SCOPE; Technique:EG
